concept_use.Orthogonality of two circles: Orthogonality of two circles: 2(g g1 + f f1) = c + c1 gives c = 9, and is checked at the end by d^2 = r1^2 + r2^2.

english: Let $\Gamma$ be the circle that cuts the circle $x^{2}+y^{2}=9$ orthogonally, passes through the point $(1,0)$ and has its centre on the line $x+y=2$. Then the $y$-coordinate of the lowest point of $\Gamma$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $\Gamma$ वह वृत्त है जो वृत्त $x^{2}+y^{2}=9$ को लम्बकोणीय रूप से काटता है, बिन्दु $(1,0)$ से होकर जाता है तथा जिसका केन्द्र रेखा $x+y=2$ पर है। तब $\Gamma$ के सबसे निचले बिन्दु का $y$-निर्देशांक ______ है।
solution: Through $(1,0)$: $1+2g+9=0\Rightarrow g=-5$ (every such circle also passes through $(9,0)$, the inverse of $(1,0)$)
solution_full: Through $(1,0)$: $1+2g+9=0$, so $g=-5$. (Every circle orthogonal to $x^{2}+y^{2}=9$ through $(1,0)$ has centre on $x=5$ and also passes through $(9,0)$, since $1\cdot9=3^{2}$.)
$\Gamma$: $x^{2}+y^{2}-10x+6y+9=0$, centre $(5,-3)$, radius $\sqrt{25+9-9}=5$. Check: distance of centres $\sqrt{34}$, and $34=9+25$.
The lowest point is $(5,-3-5)=(5,-8)$, so the required $y$-coordinate is $-8$.
originality_note: New: the orthogonality and the point condition fix c and g at once (the circles through a point and orthogonal to a circle centred at the origin all pass through the inverse point), and the line then fixes f (way 3, an object fixed by two conditions). Closest known: circle orthogonal to two given circles through a point. Different because: one condition is a line for the centre, and the hidden inverse-point structure makes c and g immediate.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, curve and parameter is introduced, the conditions are complete, there is one reading, the answer is unique and equals the Answer Plan, and the Hindi mirrors the English. Checked that the circle is unique and real. Answer -8 is a negative integer as planned. No change.
key_step: Orthogonality to a circle centred at the origin gives c = 9 directly; then g and f.
justification: Orthogonality condition and two linear conditions: routine chain. Comparable to 2026-P1-Q2 (L2).
